narrative.intro: United Concordia has $371M in federal contract obligations in FY2026 to date and 8 awards for the period. United Concordia has an average award size of $46.4M and obligations are down 7.9% year over year. United Concordia received obligations across multiple fiscal years: $438M in FY21, $507M in FY22, $384M in FY23, $387M in FY24, $403M in FY25, and $371M in FY26. United Concordia shows concentration among buying agencies, with the Department of Defense accounting for $372M in obligations in FY2026 to date. United Concordia current-year totals are partial for the fiscal year to date, and award-value figures in largest-awards and expiring-contracts tables are total contract values rather than current-year obligations.
